subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable public multi-select presentation contract, and which native channels plus fallback behavior must the first version guarantee?
rationale: The issue crosses the public plugin SDK and several channel capability boundaries, while Telegram and WhatsApp cannot implement the same interaction semantics without materially different product and security choices.

options.title: Add a phased portable contract
options.body: Approve an additive shared multi-select type with scalar-select compatibility, deterministic text fallback, and initial native Discord and Slack support before expanding channel parity.

options.title: Keep selection provider-specific
options.body: Expose native selection only through individual channel plugin APIs, avoiding a portability promise but requiring workflow authors to implement channel-specific behavior.

options.title: Defer structured selection
options.body: Retain scalar selects and numbered text replies until a broader forms or dialog product direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add a phased portable contract
recommendation.body: Approve an additive shared multi-select type with scalar-select compatibility, deterministic text fallback, and initial native Discord and Slack support before expanding channel parity.
